## Summary

### T001 — `src/slugkit/unique.py`
Implements `unique_slug(text, existing)`:
1. Computes `base = slugify(text)` (reuses spec 001's function and constants)
2. Returns `base` immediately if it's not in `existing`
3. Otherwise tries suffixes `~2`, `~3`, `~4`, … until a free slug is found
4. Trims the base so `len(trimmed_base) + len(suffix) <= SLUG_MAX`, then strips any trailing `~` before appending the suffix

### T002 — `src/slugkit/__init__.py`
Added `from slugkit.unique import unique_slug` so `from slugkit import unique_slug` works.

### T003 — `tests/test_unique.py`
Tests covering all spec rules:
- Free slug returned as-is
- Suffix `~2` added when base is taken; increments until free
- Suffixes start at 2, never 1
- `existing` set is never modified
- Result always fits within `SLUG_MAX` (even with suffix)
- Trailing `~` removed from trimmed base before suffix is added
- `EMPTY_SLUG` (`n~a`) gets suffixes too (`n~a~2`, `n~a~3`, …)
- Non-alphanumeric input that falls back to `EMPTY_SLUG` also works","time":{"start":1794539711267,"end":1794539717957}}}
